race.description: I98fm Feel Good Kembla Grange Cup Hcp (Bm64)
race.comment: EXTRA HEIGHTS (2) raced on the speed and was only a beaten conveyance close to home at his last outing over this trip at Rosehill. Draws a nice gate so should enjoy a lovely trail behind a strong tempo. The one to beat back in this company. Stablemate SKY DECK (5) continued his fine form this prep when beaten under two lengths by a smart one at the Kenso recently. Loves the 1200m here with two wins from three attempts. Genuine contender. The promising HOME MISSILE (15) is back after a four-month spell for a second campaign. Heavy supported at both runs to date and is living up to expectations. Should return bigger and better which is ominous for his opposition. MASTER YODA (9) did his best work late first-up over 1100m at Hawkesbury. Best number last prep came when he got to 1250m. Can improve sharply. MISS EMMA (10) is airborne and after the claim still gets in pretty well despite putting together back-to-back wins.
